exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 12 — See New Places, Meet New Faces
exercises.instructionUz: 12-UNIT — Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi odamlarni uchrat
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'See New Places, Meet New Faces'
  = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi yuzlarni (odamlarni) uchrat

  Bu — sayohat haqidagi ingliz maqoliga o'xshash ibora.
  'faces' (yuzlar) bu yerda 'odamlar' ma'nosida.
  'places' va 'faces' QOFIYALANADI — shuning uchun
  ibora yodda yaxshi qoladi.


UNIT 12 NING ASOSIY MAVZUSI:
  QIYOSLASh (Comparisons) —
  ikki joyni bir-biri bilan solishtirish.


BETDAGI IKKI ShAHAR:

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON
    • Angliyadagi TINCh shaharcha
    • Eyvon (Avon) daryosi bo'yida
    • Uilyam Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi
    • Rasmlarda: eski yog'och uylar, somon tomli uy,
      daryo va qayiq, cherkov minorasi

  LOS ANGELES (LA)
    • AQShdagi ShOVQINLI katta shahar
    • Kaliforniya shtatida
    • Rasmlarda: baland osmono'par binolar, ko'p mashina,
      gavjum ko'chalar, 'HILTON' mehmonxonasi


'UPON' NIMA?
  'Stratford-UPON-Avon' = Eyvon daryosi USTIDAGI Stratford.
  'upon' — 'on' ning eski, rasmiy shakli.
  Angliyada daryo bo'yidagi shaharlar shunday ataladi
  (Newcastle-upon-Tyne, Henley-on-Thames).


'LA' QISQARTMASI:
  'LA' — Los Angeles ning qisqartmasi,
  'el-EY' deb o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjective-noun collocations to these places.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN IKKI USTUN:

  SIFATLAR (qarama-qarshi juftliklar):
     quiet    -  noisy
     clean    -  dirty/polluted
     tall     -  small
     cheap    -  expensive
     modern   -  old
     exciting -  boring

  OTLAR:
     place
     streets
     buildings/houses
     shops/hotels/restaurants
     city/town
     nightlife


HAR BIR JUFTLIK QAYSI OTGA MOS KELADI:

  quiet / noisy          →  PLACE
     (tinch joy / shovqinli joy)

  clean / dirty-polluted →  STREETS
     (toza ko'chalar / iflos ko'chalar)

  tall / small           →  BUILDINGS / HOUSES
     (baland binolar / kichik uylar)

  cheap / expensive      →  ShOPS / HOTELS / RESTAURANTS
     (arzon do'konlar / qimmat do'konlar)

  modern / old           →  CITY / TOWN
     (zamonaviy shahar / eski shaharcha)

  exciting / boring      →  NIGHTLIFE
     (qiziqarli tungi hayot / zerikarli tungi hayot)


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — MANTIQ:
  Har bir sifat juftligi FAQAT bitta otga tabiiy
  ravishda yopishadi:
    • ko'chalar TOZA yoki IFLOS bo'ladi
    • binolar BALAND yoki KIChIK bo'ladi
    • do'konlar ARZON yoki QIMMAT bo'ladi
    • tungi hayot QIZIQARLI yoki ZERIKARLI bo'ladi
  Bu — 'collocation' (so'z birikmasi) deyiladi:
  ma'lum so'zlar bir-biri bilan ODATDA birga keladi.


DIQQAT — 'TALL' va 'SMALL' TENG JUFTLIK EMAS:
  'tall' ning aniq aksi — 'short'.
  Lekin binolar haqida gapirganda ingliz tilida
  'tall buildings' ↔ 'small houses' deyiladi.
  Kitob shuning uchun shu juftlikni bergan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Stratford is a quiet place, WHILE LA is a noisy place.'
  'The streets in Stratford are ...'

QOLIP:
  [Stratford haqida] , WHILE [LA haqida] .

'WHILE' NIMA QILADI:
  'while' — QARAMA-QARShI QO'YISh bog'lovchisi
  ('holbuki', 'esa' ma'nosida).
  Ikki narsani solishtirganda ishlatiladi.
  Undan OLDIN VERGUL qo'yiladi.

  DIQQAT: 'while' ning boshqa ma'nosi ham bor —
  'paytida' (While I was cooking, he arrived).
  Bu yerda esa 'esa/holbuki' ma'nosida.


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Stratford is a quiet place, while LA is a noisy
     place.                                    (NAMUNA)

  2  The streets in Stratford are clean, while the
     streets in LA are dirty and polluted.

  3  The houses in Stratford are small, while the
     buildings in LA are tall.

  4  The shops and restaurants in Stratford are cheap,
     while those in LA are expensive.

  5  Stratford is an old town, while LA is a modern city.

  6  The nightlife in Stratford is boring, while the
     nightlife in LA is exciting.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Stratford tinch joy, LA esa shovqinli joy.
  2  Stratforddagi ko'chalar toza, LA dagi ko'chalar esa
     iflos va ifloslangan.
  3  Stratforddagi uylar kichik, LA dagi binolar esa baland.
  4  Stratforddagi do'kon va restoranlar arzon,
     LA dagilari esa qimmat.
  5  Stratford eski shaharcha, LA esa zamonaviy shahar.
  6  Stratforddagi tungi hayot zerikarli, LA dagi tungi
     hayot esa qiziqarli.


DIQQAT — 'THOSE' TAKRORDAN QUTQARADI:
  4-gapda 'the shops and restaurants in LA' o'rniga
  'THOSE in LA' deyish mumkin —
  bu ingliz tilida ancha tabiiyroq.

DIQQAT — 'IN' PREDLOGI:
  'the streets IN Stratford' — shahar ichidagi narsa
  uchun IN ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and use the adjectives below to compare the two places, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va quyidagi sifatlardan foydalanib ikki joyni solishtiring, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN 9 TA SIFAT (allaqachon QIYOSIY shaklda):
  noisier, more expensive, cleaner, quieter, more modern,
  more polluted, cheaper, older, more crowded

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  LA is NOISIER THAN Stratford.
  LA is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN Stratford.


QIYOSIY DARAJA QOIDASI (Unit 12 ning asosiy grammatikasi):

  QISQA sifat (1 bo'g'in) → sifat + -ER + THAN
     old    → older    than
     cheap  → cheaper  than
     clean  → cleaner  than
     quiet  → quieter  than

  '-Y' bilan tugagan sifat → -Y tushadi, -IER qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  than
     dirty  → dirtIER  than
     easy   → easIER   than

  UZUN sifat (2+ bo'g'in) → MORE + sifat + THAN
     expensive → MORE expensive than
     modern    → MORE modern    than
     polluted  → MORE polluted  than
     crowded   → MORE crowded   than
     exciting  → MORE exciting  than

  DIQQAT: 'more noisier' yoki 'more cheaper' XATO —
  IKKALASINI BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.


BARCHA TO'QQIZ GAP:

   1  LA is NOISIER than Stratford.            (NAMUNA)
   2  LA is MORE EXPENSIVE than Stratford.     (NAMUNA)
   3  Stratford is CLEANER than LA.
   4  Stratford is QUIETER than LA.
   5  LA is MORE MODERN than Stratford.
   6  LA is MORE POLLUTED than Stratford.
   7  Stratford is CHEAPER than LA.
   8  Stratford is OLDER than LA.
   9  LA is MORE CROWDED than Stratford.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  LA Stratforddan shovqinliroq.
   2  LA Stratforddan qimmatroq.
   3  Stratford LA dan tozaroq.
   4  Stratford LA dan tinchroq.
   5  LA Stratforddan zamonaviyroq.
   6  LA Stratforddan ifloslanganroq.
   7  Stratford LA dan arzonroq.
   8  Stratford LA dan eskiroq.
   9  LA Stratforddan gavjumroq.


QAYSI ShAHAR OLDINDA TURADI — MANTIQ:
  Kitob 1-mashqda aytdi: Stratford — TINCh shaharcha,
  LA — ShOVQINLI shahar.
  Shunga ko'ra:
    LA oldinda:        noisier, more expensive,
                       more modern, more polluted,
                       more crowded
    Stratford oldinda: cleaner, quieter, cheaper, older

  Har bir gapni TESKARI ham aytish mumkin
  (Stratford is quieter than LA = LA is noisier than
  Stratford), lekin yuqoridagi shakl eng tabiiy.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  crowded  = gavjum, odam ko'p
  polluted = ifloslangan

exercises.instructionEn: The sentences below describe LA. Try to fill in the missing adjectives, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplar LA ni tasvirlaydi. Yetishmayotgan sifatlarni to'ldirishga harakat qiling, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — har birida sifatning BIRINChI HARFI berilgan.
Bu — javobni topishga yordam beradigan ip.

TO'LIQ GAPLAR (to'ldirilgan holda):

  1  The hotels in LA are more EXPENSIVE than those in
     many other American cities.
  2  There are many INTERESTING places you can visit.
  3  There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at.
  4  You can buy CHEAP, fashionable clothes on Melrose
     Avenue.
  5  The nightlife is EXCITING.
  6  LA is a modern, NOISY and crowded city.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika
     shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq.
  2  Siz borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli
     joylar bor.
  3  Siz ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib
     restoranlar bor.
  4  Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib
     olishingiz mumkin.
  5  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli.
  6  LA — zamonaviy, shovqinli va gavjum shahar.


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  1  'more E......' — 'more' bor, demak UZUN sifat.
     1 va 2-mashq ro'yxatlarida 'e' bilan boshlanadigan
     uzun sifat: EXPENSIVE. Mehmonxona haqida —
     mos keladi. ANIQ.

  2  'many I...... places you can visit' —
     borish mumkin bo'lgan joylar → INTERESTING.
     Bu — turg'un birikma ('interesting places').
     ANIQ.

  3  'There are F...... restaurants' —
     'f' bilan boshlanadigan sifat na 1-mashq, na
     2-mashq ro'yxatida yo'q. LEKIN 83-betdagi maqola
     shu gapni SO'ZMA-SO'Z takrorlaydi:
     'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at.'
     → FAMOUS. ANIQ.

  4  'C......, fashionable clothes' —
     vergul bilan ikkinchi sifat 'fashionable' berilgan.
     'c' bilan boshlanadigan, narx haqidagi sifat:
     CHEAP (1-mashq ro'yxatidan). ANIQ.

  5  'The nightlife is E......' —
     1-mashqda 'nightlife' juftligi aynan
     'exciting - boring' edi. 'e' → EXCITING. ANIQ.

  6  'a modern, N...... and crowded city' —
     1-mashqda 'quiet - NOISY' juftligi 'place' uchun,
     va kitob birinchi qatorida LA ni
     'a NOISY city in the USA' deb atagan.
     'n' → NOISY. ANIQ.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI SIFATLAR TARTIBI:
  'a modern, noisy and crowded city'
  Uch sifat: birinchi ikkitasi VERGUL bilan,
  oxirgisidan oldin 'AND' qo'yiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  fashionable = moda, zamonaviy (kiyim haqida)
  an avenue   = keng ko'cha, avenyu
  Melrose Avenue = LA dagi mashhur savdo ko'chasi
  famous      = mashhur
  to visit    = borib ko'rmoq, tashrif buyurmoq

tasks.prompt: 1  The hotels in LA are more e............ than those in many other American cities.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'more' bor → UZUN sifat kerak.
'e' + narx + mehmonxona → EXPENSIVE.
2-mashqda ham 'more expensive' berilgan.
DIQQAT: 'those' = 'the hotels' o'rniga —
takrordan qutqaradi.
tasks.speak: 1  The hotels in LA are more e............ than those in many other American cities.

tasks.prompt: 2  There are many i............ places you can visit.
tasks.promptUz: Borib ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan joylar qanday?
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'interesting places' — turg'un birikma.
'many' dan keyin KO'PLIK ot ('places').
'you can visit' — 'places' ni aniqlaydi
('which' tushirib qoldirilgan).
tasks.speak: 2  There are many i............ places you can visit.

tasks.prompt: 3  There are f............ restaurants you can eat at.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ — 83-betdagi maqoladan TASDIQLANGAN.
Maqolaning 'EATING OUT' bo'limi so'zma-so'z shunday
boshlanadi: 'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can
eat at, like the Buffalo Club ...'
'famous' = mashhur.
DIQQAT: 'eat AT' — predlog gap oxirida
(restoranDA ovqatlanmoq).
tasks.speak: 3  There are f............ restaurants you can eat at.

tasks.prompt: 4  You can buy c............, fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'c' + narx → CHEAP (1-mashq ro'yxatidan).
Ma'no ham mos: 'arzon, lekin moda kiyimlar'.
'Melrose Avenue' — LA dagi mashhur savdo ko'chasi.
'ON ... Avenue' — ko'cha bilan predlog ON.
tasks.speak: 4  You can buy c............, fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue.

tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
1-mashqda 'nightlife' juftligi aynan
'exciting - boring' edi.
'e' → EXCITING.
LA — shovqinli, gavjum shahar → tungi hayoti
ZERIKARLI emas, QIZIQARLI.

tasks.prompt: 6  LA is a modern, n............ and crowded city.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
Kitobning 1-mashqdagi birinchi qatori:
'Los Angeles, a NOISY city in the USA'.
'n' → NOISY.
DIQQAT: uch sifat ketma-ket —
'modern, noisy AND crowded'.
tasks.speak: 6  LA is a modern, n............ and crowded city.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  film, heavy, 24-hour, sunny, designer,
  famous, expensive, make

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SUNNY weather        (quyoshli ob-havo)
  2  HEAVY traffic        (zich transport oqimi)
  3  EXPENSIVE shops      (qimmat do'konlar)
  4  FILM stars           (kino yulduzlari)
  5  to MAKE films        (film suratga olmoq)
  6  DESIGNER clothes     (dizayner kiyimlar)
  7  24-HOUR cafes        (24 soat ishlaydigan kafelar)
  8  FAMOUS restaurants   (mashhur restoranlar)


HAMMASI 83-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN:
  'sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic'
  'the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'
  'It's also home to FILM STARS'
  'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE FILMS'
  'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
  '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'
  'There are FAMOUS RESTAURANTS you can eat at'


DIQQAT — 5-BAND BOShQAChA:
  Ro'yxatdagi 7 ta so'z SIFAT yoki OT,
  faqat 'make' — FE'L.
  Bo'shliqdan oldin 'to' turgani shuni ko'rsatadi:
  'TO ...... films' → 'TO MAKE films'.

DIQQAT — '24-HOUR' YOZILIShI:
  Sifat sifatida ishlatilganda 'hour' KO'PLIK
  BO'LMAYDI: '24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO).
  Xuddi shunday: 'a five-minute walk',
  'a ten-year-old boy'.

DIQQAT — 'FILM STARS' va 'DESIGNER CLOTHES':
  Bu yerda birinchi so'z OT bo'lsa ham,
  SIFAT vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).

DIQQAT — 'HEAVY' NING MA'NOSI:
  'heavy' = og'ir. Lekin 'heavy traffic' = zich
  transport oqimi (og'ir transport EMAS).
  Shuningdek: 'heavy rain' = kuchli yomg'ir.

tasks.whyUz:
Ob-havo haqidagi yagona sifat — SUNNY.
Maqola: 'sunny weather'.
'sunny' = quyoshli (sun + -ny).

'HEAVY traffic' — turg'un birikma.
Maqola: 'tall buildings and heavy traffic'.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'heavy' = ZICH, og'ir emas.

Maqola: 'go to the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'.
'expensive' = qimmat.

'FILM stars' = kino yulduzlari.
Maqola: 'It's also home to film stars'.
DIQQAT: 'film' bu yerda OT, lekin SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi.

Bo'shliqdan oldin 'TO' turibdi →
FE'L kerak. Ro'yxatdagi yagona fe'l — MAKE.
Maqola: 'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE
FILMS'.
DIQQAT: ingliz tilida 'MAKE a film' deyiladi
('do a film' EMAS).

Maqola: 'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
'designer clothes' = mashhur dizayner yaratgan,
qimmat kiyimlar.
83-betdagi C rasmi.

Maqola: '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'.
= 24 soat, tunu kun ishlaydigan kafelar.
DIQQAT: sifat sifatida 'hour' KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.

Maqola: 'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can
eat at'.
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi ham shu edi.
'famous' = mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.instructionUz: To'ldiring: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI PREDLOG, 10 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari BIR NEChA marta ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  the second largest city IN America
   2  it's home TO film stars
   3  close TO special bus-stops
   4  footprints OF film stars
   5  you can get rides TO the various sights
   6  eat AT a restaurant
   7  packed WITH celebrities
   8  IN the world
   9  ON Rodeo Drive
  10  popular WITH visitors


QAYSI PREDLOG NECHA MARTA:
  TO   — 3 marta (2, 3, 5)
  IN   — 2 marta (1, 8)
  WITH — 2 marta (7, 10)
  OF   — 1 marta (4)
  AT   — 1 marta (6)
  ON   — 1 marta (9)


QOIDALAR:

  IN + katta joy (mamlakat, shahar, dunyo)
     in America, in the world, in Tashkent

  ON + ko'cha, avenyu
     on Rodeo Drive, on Melrose Avenue
     DIQQAT: 'in' EMAS!

  AT + aniq nuqta (bino, muassasa)
     at a restaurant, at a hotel, at school

  TO + yo'nalish yoki yaqinlik
     home TO ... (makoni)
     close TO ... (yaqin)
     rides TO ... (qayerga)

  OF + egalik / tegishlilik
     footprints OF film stars

  WITH + birgalik yoki to'lganlik
     packed WITH, popular WITH


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR:
  be home TO ...     = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq
  close TO ...       = ... ga yaqin
  packed WITH ...    = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  popular WITH ...   = ... orasida mashhur

tasks.whyUz:
MAMLAKAT bilan IN.
'in America', 'in Uzbekistan'.

'be home TO ...' — turg'un birikma
(... ning makoni bo'lmoq).
DIQQAT: 'home OF' EMAS.

'close TO ...' — turg'un birikma (... ga yaqin).
DIQQAT: 'close FROM' XATO.

EGALIK: kimning izlari? → film stars NING.
'OF' egalikni bildiradi.

tasks.prompt: 5  you can get rides ........ the various sights
tasks.whyUz:
YO'NALISh: qayerga? → sights GA.
'a ride TO ...' = ... ga yo'l/sayohat.
tasks.speak: 5  you can get rides ........ the various sights

tasks.whyUz:
'eat AT a restaurant' — muassasa bilan AT.
83-betdagi maqola: 'eat AT the Border Grill'.
DIQQAT: 'eat IN a restaurant' ham aytiladi,
lekin kitob 'at' shaklini o'rgatadi.

'packed WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... bilan to'lib ketgan).
TO'LGANLIK har doim WITH bilan.

'IN the world' — turg'un birikma.

WORLD'.

KO'ChA bilan ON.
'ON Rodeo Drive', 'ON Melrose Avenue'.
DIQQAT: 'in Rodeo Drive' XATO.

'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... orasida mashhur).
DIQQAT: 'popular AMONG' ham to'g'ri, lekin

exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIM — bir xil ma'noli boshqa so'z.

RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  district, not dangerous, memorable, well-known,
  interesting, near

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  safe          =  NOT DANGEROUS
  2  close         =  NEAR
  3  fascinating   =  INTERESTING
  4  famous        =  WELL-KNOWN
  5  unforgettable =  MEMORABLE
  6  area          =  DISTRICT


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  safe (xavfsiz) = not dangerous (xavfli emas)
     'dangerous' ning INKORI.
     Maqola: 'they are clean and SAFE'.

  close (yaqin) = near (yaqin)
     Ikkalasi ham masofani bildiradi.
     DIQQAT: 'close' predlogi TO,
     'near' esa predlogsiz: 'near the school'.

  fascinating (maftunkor) = interesting (qiziqarli)
     'fascinating' — kuchliroq shakl.
     Maqola oxiri: 'but it's also FASCINATING'.

  famous (mashhur) = well-known (yaxshi tanilgan)
     'well-known' = well + known (chiziqcha bilan).

  unforgettable (unutilmas) = memorable (esda qolarli)
     'memorable' — 'memory' (xotira) dan.
     'unforgettable' — un + forget + able.

  area (hudud) = district (tuman, hudud)
     Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.


NIMANI O'RGATADI:
  Bir gapni turlicha aytish mumkin:
     'The hotels are safe.'
     'The hotels are not dangerous.'
  Yozishda TAKRORDAN qochish uchun sinonimlar
  kerak bo'ladi.

'safe' = xavfsiz.

Yagona INKOR shaklidagi variant.

5-mashqning 8-bandi: 'famous restaurants'.

'memorable' = esda qolarli ('memory' dan).
'unforgettable' = un + forget + able = unutilmas.
Maqola: 'A visit there is always UNFORGETTABLE.'

Ikkalasi ham 'hudud'.
Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.

exercises.instructionEn: Los Angeles — The City of Angels
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  LOS ANGELES — THE CITY OF ANGELS

  Los Angeles is THE SECOND LARGEST city in America.
  It's also home to film stars, SUNNY weather, TALL
  buildings and HEAVY traffic.

  ACCOMMODATION
  The hotels in LA are MORE EXPENSIVE than those in many
  other American cities, but they are CLEAN and safe.
  The Biltmore and The Omni are lovely, and close to
  special bus-stops where you can get CHEAP rides to the
  various sights.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  There are many INTERESTING places you can visit, like
  Venice Beach with its street performers, Universal
  Studios to see how they make films, and Griffith Park.
  You can also see the handprints and footprints of film
  stars outside Grauman's Chinese Theatre. Children can
  visit the Children's Museum — one of THE MOST EXCITING
  museums in the world.

  EATING OUT
  There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at, like the
  Buffalo Club, a place packed with celebrities, or
  Musso & Frank's, Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant. For
  THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes, eat at the Border
  Grill.

  SHOPPING
  You can buy CHEAP FASHIONABLE clothes on Melrose
  Avenue. Do you want designer clothes? Then go to the
  EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive. A visit there is always
  UNFORGETTABLE.

  ENTERTAINMENT
  The nightlife is EXCITING on the Sunset Strip, an area
  in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and
  The Roxy. There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music.
  24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear are popular with
  visitors.

  LA is a MODERN city with something for everyone. It's
  NOISY AND CROWDED, but it's also FASCINATING.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  LOS-ANJELES — FARIShTALAR ShAHRI

  Los-Anjeles Amerikadagi ikkinchi eng katta shahar.
  U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo,
  baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.

  TURAR JOY
  LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika
  shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq, lekin ular toza va
  xavfsiz. 'Biltmore' va 'Omni' — ajoyib, va siz
  diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borishingiz
  mumkin bo'lgan maxsus avtobus bekatlariga yaqin.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar
  bor: ko'cha artistlari bilan Venis-Bich, filmlarni
  qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rish uchun 'Universal
  Studios' va Griffit parki. Shuningdek Grauman Xitoy
  teatri oldida kino yulduzlarining qo'l va oyoq
  izlarini ko'rishingiz mumkin. Bolalar Bolalar
  muzeyiga borishlari mumkin — bu dunyodagi eng
  qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.

  TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar
  bor: masalan, mashhur odamlar to'lib ketgan 'Buffalo
  Club' yoki Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran 'Musso &
  Frank's'. Eng mazali meksika taomlari uchun 'Border
  Grill' ga boring.

  XARID QILISh
  Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib
  olishingiz mumkin. Dizayner kiyimlar xohlaysizmi?
  Unda Rodeo-Drayvdagi qimmat do'konlarga boring.
  U yerga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.

  KO'NGILOChAR
  Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur
  klublar joylashgan Sanset-Strip hududida tungi hayot
  juda qiziqarli. U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin. 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat
  ishlaydigan kafelar sayyohlar orasida mashhur.

  LA — har kim uchun biror narsasi bor zamonaviy shahar.
  U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.


SARLAVHANING MA'NOSI:
  'Los Angeles' ispanchada 'Farishtalar' degani
  ('los angeles' = the angels).
  Shuning uchun shaharning laqabi —
  'The City of Angels' (Farishtalar shahri).


MAQOLADAGI QIYOSIY VA ORTTIRMA DARAJALAR
(Unit 12 ning grammatikasi — MATNDAN toping):

  QIYOSIY (-er / more ... than):
     more expensive than

  ORTTIRMA (the ...-est / the most ...):
     THE SECOND LARGEST city
     one of THE MOST EXCITING museums
     Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant
     THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes

  DIQQAT: orttirma daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.
  'the largest', 'the oldest', 'the most exciting'.
  Bu — 84-betda batafsil o'rganiladi.


MAQOLADAGI ATOQLI OTLAR:
  The Biltmore, The Omni  — mehmonxonalar
  Venice Beach            — plyaj (ko'cha artistlari)
  Universal Studios       — kinostudiya
  Griffith Park           — park
  Grauman's Chinese Theatre — kinoteatr (yulduzlar izlari)
  Children's Museum       — Bolalar muzeyi
  Buffalo Club, Musso & Frank's, Border Grill — restoranlar
  Melrose Avenue, Rodeo Drive — savdo ko'chalari
  Sunset Strip            — ko'ngilochar hudud
  The Whiskey, The Roxy   — klublar
  Van Go's Ear            — 24 soatlik kafe


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  accommodation = turar joy
  a sight       = diqqatga sazovor joy
  various       = turli xil
  a ride        = yo'l, sayohat (transportda)
  a performer   = artist, ijrochi
  a handprint   = qo'l izi
  a footprint   = oyoq izi
  packed with   = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  a celebrity   = mashhur odam
  delicious     = mazali
  designer clothes = dizayner kiyimlar
  unforgettable = unutilmas
  entertainment = ko'ngilochar
  fascinating   = maftunkor
  heavy traffic = zich transport oqimi

 │              │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)   │    (orttirma)    │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ BIR BO'G'INLI│  cheap    │  cheapER      │ THE cheapEST     │
 │   sifatlar   │  large    │  largER       │ THE largEST      │
 │              │  big      │  bigGER       │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y bilan     │  noisy    │  noisIER      │ THE noisIEST     │
 │  tugaganlar  │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ IKKI yoki    │ expensive │ MORE expensive│ THE MOST         │
 │ undan ko'p   │           │               │  expensive       │
 │  bo'g'inli   │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │              │  good     │  better       │ THE best         │
 │  NOTO'G'RI   │  bad      │  worse        │ THE worst        │
 │   sifatlar   │ much/many │  more         │ THE most         │
 │              │  little   │  less         │ THE least        │
 └──────────────┴───────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────┘


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  sifat + -ER
   orttirma: THE + sifat + -EST

   MAXSUS HOLATLAR:
     • '-e' bilan tugasa → faqat -R / -ST
        large → largER → the largEST
        safe  → safER  → the safEST
     • BITTA unli + BITTA undosh bilan tugasa →
       oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI
        big → bigGER → the bigGEST
        hot → hotTER → the hotTEST
        fat → fatTER → the fatTEST

2) '-Y' bilan tugagan sifatlar
   '-y' tushadi, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  → the noisIEST
     easy   → easIER   → the easIEST
     happy  → happIER  → the happIEST
     dirty  → dirtIER  → the dirtIEST

3) IKKI va undan KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  MORE + sifat
   orttirma: THE MOST + sifat
     expensive → MORE expensive → THE MOST expensive
     modern    → MORE modern    → THE MOST modern
     beautiful → MORE beautiful → THE MOST beautiful

4) NOTO'G'RI sifatlar — YODLASh kerak
     good        → better → the best
     bad         → worse  → the worst
     much / many → more   → the most
     little      → less   → the least

   DIQQAT: 'gooder', 'baddest', 'more good' —
   HAMMASI XATO.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ more cheaper    ✓ cheaper
  ✗ more noisier    ✓ noisier
  ✗ the most oldest ✓ the oldest
  ✗ gooder          ✓ better
  ✗ cheapest city   ✓ THE cheapest city

  ASOSIY QOIDA: -ER/-EST va MORE/MOST ni
  BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
  ORTTIRMA daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA (comparative form)
   IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   Odatda 'THAN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Parthenon is OLDER THAN the Colosseum.'
     (Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative form)
   IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Great Pyramid of Cheops is THE OLDEST OF ALL.'
     (Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski.)


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS
   Ikki narsani TENGLIK bo'yicha solishtiradi.

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford-upon-Avon ISN'T AS NOISY AS LA.'
     (Stratford LA chalik shovqinli emas.)

   DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     'A is AS big AS B'      = A B chalik katta (TENG)
     'A ISN'T AS big AS B'   = A B chalik katta emas
                               (A kichikroq)

   DIQQAT: 'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY
   shakli qo'yiladi ('as noisier as' XATO).


4) MUCH + qiyosiy daraja
   Farqni KUChAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford is MUCH QUIETER than LA.'
     (Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq.)

   DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan,
   oddiy sifat bilan EMAS ('much quiet' XATO).


BETDAGI UCh TARIXIY YODGORLIK (rasmlarda):

  The Great Pyramid of Cheops  —  2465 BC (m.a.)
     Misrdagi Xeops piramidasi — ENG ESKI

  The Parthenon                —  438 BC (m.a.)
     Afinadagi Parfenon ibodatxonasi — o'rtada

  The Colosseum                —  82 AD (milodiy)
     Rimdagi Kolizey — ENG YANGI

  'BC' = Before Christ = miloddan avvalgi
  'AD' = Anno Domini   = milodiy

  DIQQAT — SANALARNI TAQQOSLASh:
  'BC' sanalarida son KATTA bo'lsa,
  vaqt UZOQROQ (eskiroq).
  2465 BC > 438 BC → piramida Parfenondan ESKIROQ.


ShU UCh YODGORLIK BILAN GAPLAR:
  The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
  The Great Pyramid is older than the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
  The Colosseum is the newest of the three.
  The Colosseum isn't as old as the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid is much older than the Colosseum.

RO'YXAT (13 ta sifat):
  large, clean, noisy, polluted, crowded, small, dirty,

KITOBDAGI BESh NAMUNA — TO'RT XIL QOLIP:

  1  LA is LARGER THAN my town.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN

  2  My town is CLEANER THAN LA.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN (teskari yo'nalishda)

  3  LA is MUCH NOISIER THAN my town.
     → MUCH + qiyosiy daraja (kuchaytirish)

  4  My town is AS NOISY AS LA.
     → AS + oddiy sifat + AS (tenglik)

  5  My town ISN'T AS POLLUTED AS LA.
     → ISN'T AS + oddiy sifat + AS (inkor)


BARCHA 13 SIFAT BILAN NAMUNA GAPLAR
(o'z shahringiz nomini qo'ying):

   large     — LA is larger than my town.
   clean     — My town is cleaner than LA.
   noisy     — LA is much noisier than my town.
   polluted  — My town isn't as polluted as LA.
   crowded   — LA is more crowded than my town.
   small     — My town is smaller than LA.
   dirty     — LA is dirtier than my town.
   safe      — My town is safer than LA.
   expensive — LA is much more expensive than my town.
   old       — My town is older than LA.
   modern    — LA is more modern than my town.
   peaceful  — My town is more peaceful than LA.
   cheap     — My town is cheaper than LA.


QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:

  -ER oladiganlar (bir bo'g'inli):
     large → larger,  small → smaller,
     safe  → safer,   old   → older,
     clean → cleaner, cheap → cheaper

  -IER oladiganlar ('-y' bilan tugagan):
     noisy → noisier,  dirty → dirtier

  MORE oladiganlar (uzun):
     polluted  → more polluted
     crowded   → more crowded
     expensive → more expensive
     modern    → more modern
     peaceful  → more peaceful


DIQQAT — 'MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE':
  'much' + 'more expensive' — ikkalasi birga
  KELISHI mumkin, chunki 'more expensive' —
  bitta qiyosiy shakl, 'much' esa uni kuchaytiradi.

DIQQAT — QARAMA-QARShI JUFTLIKLAR RO'YXATDA:
  large ↔ small        clean ↔ dirty
  noisy ↔ peaceful     expensive ↔ cheap
  old   ↔ modern
  Har juftlikning BIRINI tanlab, gapni
  ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'LA is larger than my town.'
     'My town is smaller than LA.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.

YANGI SO'Z:
  peaceful = tinch, osoyishta
             ('peace' — tinchlik dan)

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'you can visit' otni aniqlaydi.
Predlog ('at') gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + sifat + KO'PLIK ot + you can + fe'l ( + predlog).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are many interesting places you can visit. There are famous restaurants you can eat at.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar bor. Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolalarining asosiy qolipi.
Predlog ('at') gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can buy cheap fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue, like designer clothes on Rodeo Drive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: one of THE MOST + sifat + KO'PLIK ot
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: one of the most exciting museums in the world
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'one of the ...' dan keyin DOIM KO'PLIK ot.
ORTTIRMA daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + sifat, BUT it's also + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's noisy and crowded, but it's also fascinating.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Maqolani XULOSA bilan tugatish qolipi:
kamchilikni aytib, keyin ijobiy nota bilan yakunlash.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's also home to film stars, sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo, baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be home TO' = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq.
Shahar yoki mamlakat tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [sifat]-ER / MORE [sifat] THAN B.   (IKKI narsa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum. LA is more expensive than my town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq. LA mening shahrimdan qimmatroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — IKKITA narsani solishtiradi.
Doim 'THAN' bilan.
Qisqa sifat → -ER, uzun sifat → MORE.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is THE [sifat]-EST / THE MOST [sifat] OF/IN ... .   (IKKIDAN KO'P)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all. It's one of the most exciting museums in the world.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski. Bu dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja — IKKIDAN KO'P narsani solishtiradi.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.
'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.   /   A ISN'T AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My town is as noisy as LA. Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening shahrim LA chalik shovqinli. Stratford LA chalik shovqinli emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TENGLIK qolipi.
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli
('as noisier as' XATO).
Inkor shakli — A ning B dan KAM ekanini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is MUCH + [qiyosiy daraja] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Stratford is much quieter than LA. LA is much more expensive than my town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq. LA mening shahrimdan ancha qimmatroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'much' farqni KUCHAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ('much quiet' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: ot + ot birikmasi (birinchi ot SIFAT vazifasida)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: film stars, designer clothes, 24-hour cafes, bus-stops
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kino yulduzlari, dizayner kiyimlar, 24 soatlik kafelar, avtobus bekatlari
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI:
'24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO),
'film stars' ('films stars' XATO).
